input.summary:
stg_order_items failed on both attempts for logical_date 2026-10-28 with InsufficientPrivilege (SQLSTATE 42501): "permission denied for table products". Because it failed, stg.order_items for that date was never written, and its three downstream marts (daily_gmv_by_region, inventory_health, sku_sell_through) are missing that partition too. The table named in the error is raw.products, a static dimension table that no DAG task writes and that stg_order_items joins to. So the root entity is that table's grant, not the task. Reasons:
(1) The failure is new. Every earlier run of stg_order_items (2026-10-21 to 10-27) succeeded, the last one at 2026-10-28 02:52 UTC.
(2) No code was deployed to any task in the last 120 hours, so a bad deploy is ruled out.
(3) Upstream data is fine: raw.order_items has 739 rows for 10-28 (in line with earlier days), and raw.products still exists with 50 rows. My query role can read it, but I can't check the pipeline role's grants because information_schema is outside my allowed schemas.
This matches the permission runbook and a March 2026 postmortem where a role cleanup revoked SELECT on raw.products from the pipeline role rca_app. The most likely cause is that rca_app lost SELECT on raw.products some time between 02:52 and 08:27 UTC on 10-28, either by a revoke or because the table was recreated without its grants. I couldn't confirm the grant change directly, so data platform needs to check it. No suspicious instruction-like text showed up in the tool outputs.

evidence.excerpt: Task failed with InsufficientPrivilege: permission denied for table products

`permission denied for table products` means `raw.products`, even
   though the failing task is `stg_order_items`. The table in the error is the root entity.

hypotheses_considered: Revoked SELECT grant on raw.products for pipeline role rca_app (most likely)
raw.products recreated by a migration, dropping its grants (possible; data platform should check)
Bad deploy to stg_order_items (rejected: no deploys in 120h)
Late/missing upstream raw.order_items (rejected: 739 rows present for 2026-10-28)
Transient/flaky failure (rejected: failed on both attempts, never failed before)

Also find out what removed it: an access-review/role-cleanup script, or the table being recreated without default privileges.
proposed_actions.rationale: The pipeline role appears to have lost SELECT on raw.products. Fixing grants needs DBA/platform rights, and the runbook says grants should only be changed through migrations.

## Summary
A quarterly access review script removed "unused" grants and revoked `SELECT` on `raw.products`
from the pipeline role `rca_app`. The next run of `stg_order_items` failed with
`InsufficientPrivilege: permission denied for table products`; its three marts were skipped.

## Impact
- Order-line staging and all product-level marts missing for one logical date.

## Investigation
- The failing task was stg_order_items, but the object in the error was `raw.products`, a static
  dimension table that no DAG task writes. The root entity was the table, not the task.
- `information_schema.role_table_grants` showed rca_app had lost SELECT; the review script's audit
  log confirmed the revoke.

## Resolution
The data platform team restored the grant through a migration; `stg_order_items` was rerun and the
marts backfilled.

## Root cause
The review script judged usage from a 30-day query log that missed reads made by a role through a
join in a single nightly task.

## Action items
- Manage pipeline grants only through migrations; exclude pipeline roles from the review script.
